content: Query-log replay without clicks measures stability, not quality: replay each logged query and compare its top-k against a saved baseline snapshot. Practical metrics are mean Jaccard@k over the document-id/path sets, top-1 stability (share of queries whose #1 result is unchanged), and worst-regression lists; Jaccard ignores ordering so pair it with a rank metric or top-1. The operational pattern (gbrain/memem eval_replay) is capture -> baseline.ndjson -> code change -> replay --against baseline. SIF's query_log is CLI-only (MCP never writes it) and capped at 500 rows, so the replay set is biased and must be labeled stability-vs-baseline, never quality.
